import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder

# 1. 导入数据
train_path = r'E:\Postgraduate\Code\SunnylnAgent\data\csv\student_performance_train.csv'
test_path = r'E:\Postgraduate\Code\SunnylnAgent\data\csv\student_performance_test.csv'

train_data = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_data = pd.read_csv(test_path)

# 2. 数据预处理
# 检查缺失值
print("训练集缺失值：", train_data.isnull().sum())
print("测试集缺失值：", test_data.isnull().sum())

# 填充缺失值（如果存在）
train_data.fillna(train_data.mean(), inplace=True)
test_data.fillna(test_data.mean(), inplace=True)

# 3. 特征选择
# 选择与目标变量（G3）相关的特征
features = [col for col in train_data.columns if col not in ['G3', 'mat', 'por']]
target = 'G3'

# 4. 处理分类变量
categorical_features = train_data[features].select_dtypes(include=['object']).columns
numeric_features = train_data[features].select_dtypes(include=['number']).columns

# 使用 OneHotEncoder 处理分类变量
encoder = OneHotEncoder(sparse=False, handle_unknown='ignore')
train_categorical = encoder.fit_transform(train_data[categorical_features])
test_categorical = encoder.transform(test_data[categorical_features])

# 合并数值特征和编码后的分类特征
train_features = np.concatenate([train_data[numeric_features].values, train_categorical], axis=1)
test_features = np.concatenate([test_data[numeric_features].values, test_categorical], axis=1)

# 5. 构建回归模型
model = LinearRegression()
model.fit(train_features, train_data[target])

# 6. 评估模型
predictions = model.predict(test_features)
mse = mean_squared_error(test_data[target], predictions)
print("测试集上的均方误差（MSE）：", mse)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder

# 1. 导入数据
train_path = r'E:\Postgraduate\Code\SunnylnAgent\data\csv\student_performance_train.csv'
test_path = r'E:\Postgraduate\Code\SunnylnAgent\data\csv\student_performance_test.csv'

train_data = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_data = pd.read_csv(test_path)

# 2. 数据预处理
# 检查缺失值
print("训练集缺失值：", train_data.isnull().sum())
print("测试集缺失值：", test_data.isnull().sum())

# 填充缺失值
numeric_features = train_data.select_dtypes(include=['number']).columns
categorical_features = train_data.select_dtypes(include=['object']).columns

# 对数值列填充均值
train_data[numeric_features] = train_data[numeric_features].fillna(train_data[numeric_features].mean())
test_data[numeric_features] = test_data[numeric_features].fillna(test_data[numeric_features].mean())

# 对分类列填充众数
train_data[categorical_features] = train_data[categorical_features].fillna(train_data[categorical_features].mode().iloc[0])
test_data[categorical_features] = test_data[categorical_features].fillna(test_data[categorical_features].mode().iloc[0])

# 3. 特征选择
# 选择与目标变量（G3）相关的特征
features = [col for col in train_data.columns if col not in ['G3', 'mat', 'por']]
target = 'G3'

# 4. 处理分类变量
encoder = OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore')
train_categorical = encoder.fit_transform(train_data[categorical_features])
test_categorical = encoder.transform(test_data[categorical_features])

# 合并数值特征和编码后的分类特征
train_features = np.concatenate([train_data[numeric_features].values, train_categorical.toarray()], axis=1)
test_features = np.concatenate([test_data[numeric_features].values, test_categorical.toarray()], axis=1)

# 5. 构建回归模型
model = LinearRegression()
model.fit(train_features, train_data[target])

# 6. 评估模型
predictions = model.predict(test_features)
mse = mean_squared_error(test_data[target], predictions)
print("测试集上的均方误差（MSE）：", mse)
